args.title: Parse quoted header fields in statement CSV parser
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The header line is split with a plain `lines[0].split(",")`, unlike data rows which use `splitFields` to handle quoted fields. When the header is quoted (e.g. `"Date","Amount","Description","Reference"`), the quote characters stay in the column names, so the required-columns check fails and every row is rejected as a shape mismatch. Change the header parsing to use `splitFields(lines[0])` (lower-cased) so quoted headers are handled the same way as quoted data rows.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser splits data rows with `splitFields`, which strips quotes, but splits the header line with a plain `lines[0].split(",")`. When the header itself is quoted, the quote characters remain in the column names, so the required-columns check fails and the whole file is rejected at row 1. The header should be parsed with `splitFields` as well.
